newsletter.index_intro: Two editions a day in summit week. The morning edition says what is on today, for those there and for those following from afar. The evening edition says what happened and what is next. Each is a page here and a short plain-text email made from it, with links. Subscribers and sending are handled by the Web Summit team, not on this site.
